Equipped with 16 ball bearings and advanced gear technology, the Shimano Iso Spinning Reel ensures effortless casting and retrieval, giving you superior control and accuracy. Its ergonomic build makes it comfortable to handle, helping you stay focused on the catch without fatigue.

  • Lightweight yet durable construction for easy handling

  • Ergonomic design for comfortable use during long fishing sessions

How to use

Attach the Shimano Iso Spinning Reel to your fishing rod securely. Use the reel to cast your line by opening the bail arm and smoothly releasing the fishing line during the cast. Retrieve the line by turning the handle, making use of the reel's smooth gear system for effortless reeling. Regularly check the reel for any debris and lubricate moving parts to maintain optimal performance.

Care instructions

After each use, rinse the reel with fresh water to remove dirt and salt. Dry thoroughly before storage to prevent corrosion. Periodically lubricate the moving parts with appropriate reel oil or grease. Avoid exposing the reel to extreme temperatures or harsh chemicals to maintain its durability and performance.
